text: The subject Fahad Mirza holds account PK**ABPA****6924 which was opened on 4 February 2023. The subject is declared as a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month. During the activity window from 4 May 2026 to 29 May 2026 the account recorded 13 credits totalling PKR 20,109,000 and 5 debits totalling PKR 16,861,000. The activity includes 12 cash deposits totalling PKR 19,989,000 made across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). The activity was flagged by Tazama on 29 May 2026, with the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scoring 320 against an alert threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold were observed, with 10 of 12 cash deposits (83%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000, consistent with structuring. More than one cash deposit occurred on the same day (14 May 2026), another red flag for structuring. The credits in the activity window were 167.6 times the declared monthly income of PKR 120,000 per month, indicating cash volume inconsistent with declared income, suggestive of structuring. Overall, the pattern of deposits just below the PKR 2,000,000 threshold, across multiple branches, with frequent same‑day deposits and volumes far exceeding the declared income of PKR 120,000 per month, is consistent with suspected structuring. PKR 8,565,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 2 transactions. PKR 4,952,000 was sent to Al-Noor Exchange Company (PK**AL-N****1888, Synthetic Bank C) in 1 transaction. PKR 3,344,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank B) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 84% of credits were withdrawn with a median of 26.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 30 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse‑media lists. On 30 May 2026 the account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
